blocks.text: An action group keeps related event creators together. NgRx derives creator names from the event labels.

Use an Angular project with the matching major version of @ngrx/store. Effects and SignalStore examples also need @ngrx/effects or @ngrx/signals. Save linked snippets in the files named by their imports.

items: The source label groups generated action types under Reading.
The Add Book event becomes an addBook creator with a required title property.

blocks.text: The generated addBook creator carries Moon Trip.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: The event label Add Book becomes the creator name addBook. Use the generated camel-case name.
